meta.name: add-atomic-chat-tool
meta.description: Add Atomic Chat MCP server so the container agent can call local models served by the Atomic Chat desktop app via its OpenAI-compatible API.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让容器代理调用本地大模型
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让容器中的智能体调用本地运行的大模型
copy.tagline_en: Enable your container agent to call local AI models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your containerized agent to use local AI models

howto.what: 给容器代理添加一个基于 stdio 的 MCP 服务器,让它能列出 Atomic Chat 桌面应用中的本地模型,并向指定模型发送提示词获取回复。Claude 仍是主控,但可把部分任务交给本地模型。
howto.when: 当用户明确要求使用 Atomic Chat 或调用 atomic_chat 相关工具时触发,例如说“用 atomic chat 告诉我国都”或“列出可用模型”。

say.text: 用 atomic chat 告诉我法国的首都
say.note: 代理会先列出模型,再选一个生成回复。

say.text: 列出 atomic chat 当前可用的模型

howto.what_en: Adds a stdio-based MCP server so the container agent can list local models from the Atomic Chat desktop app and send prompts to a chosen model for a response. Claude stays the orchestrator but can offload tasks to local models.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user explicitly asks to use Atomic Chat or references the atomic_chat tools, e.g. "use atomic chat to tell me the capital of France" or "list available models".

say_en.text: Use atomic chat to tell me the capital of France
say_en.note: The agent lists models, then picks one to generate.

say_en.text: List the models currently available in atomic chat
say_en.note: Calls atomic_chat_list_models and returns the list.

say_en.text: Use the atomic_chat_generate tool with llama3.2-3b-instruct to answer my question
say_en.note: Model ID must exactly match one from the list.
